# Codefolio (full)

> Executable JavaScript notebooks on a canvas. Notes, code, and results — one continuous document.

A browser-only TanStack Start app. The product is a freeform React Flow canvas of "notebook" nodes, each containing Markdown and JavaScript cells. There is no server, no auth, no database — everything user-visible lives under `src/`, and persistence is `localStorage` via a Zustand store.

This file is the inlined, context-bounded companion to `llms.txt`. Use it when a single fetch is preferable to chasing links.

---

## 1. What the user can do

- Open the desk — a freeform canvas of notebook "cards" the user drags and arranges.
- Each card holds ordered cells: Markdown notes and JavaScript code.
- Shift+Enter runs a cell; Cmd/Ctrl+Enter inserts a new cell beneath it.
- Top-level declarations in a cell carry into later cells (`const`, `let`, `var`, `function`).
- `@name` in a cell's source becomes a clickable chip that scrolls to the matching cell (see `cell-references.ts`).
- Cell outputs render inline beneath the cell:
  - The trailing expression's value goes through `inspect()` (`src/lib/notebook/inspect.ts`).
  - `console.log/info/warn/error` calls during the run are captured into `output.logs`.
- A welcome dialog appears for first-time visitors; an appearance dialog lets them pick a theme palette + font pairing.
- Source-import: drop a folder of `.js` / `.ts` / `.tsx` / `.jsx` / `.mjs` / `.cjs` (or a single file) onto the desk — each file becomes a notebook card with one editable source cell. Reimporting the same path updates the source cell but preserves attached notes.
- Project export: produces a reproducible ZIP — original source files, generated React entrypoint, Vite config, `package.json`, `codefolio.build.json` with the module graph, and a build smoke test. The Codefolio app uses port 5173 for dev / 4173 for preview; exported projects use 5174 / 5175.

## 2. Repo layout

```
src/
  routes/                  TanStack Start file routes
    __root.tsx             Document shell, mounts <FolioCanvas/>
    index.tsx              Home (the canvas)
  components/
    canvas/                React Flow canvas, notebook node, project preview, desk stack
    folio/                 Welcome, appearance panel, toaster, save status, confirm dialog
    notebook/              Cell renderers (code, markdown, image, video, artifact, full notebook)
    ui/                    Generic Radix + Tailwind primitives
  lib/
    artifacts/             Source-graph compiler, project export, project assistant
      compiler.ts          Source-graph walker + esbuild bundle for source cells
      project-compiler.ts  Compiles a chosen entry + its reachable graph
      project-export.ts    Builds the export ZIP
      project-assistant.ts AI-assisted replacement (libfx/node, optional)
      templates.ts         Starter Vite + React entrypoint for exported projects
      catalog.json         Bundled libraries available inside cells
    notebook/              Notebook runtime
      store.ts             Zustand store (cells, kernels, autosave)
      sandbox-kernel.ts    The iframe evaluator
      kernel-frame.ts      Source loaded into the iframe (built by build-artifacts.mjs)
      runtime.ts           Kernel state machine (run, queue, replace)
      inspect.ts           Display helpers (html, md, table)
      persistence.ts       localStorage + IndexedDB-backed desk storage
      workspaces.ts        Multi-workspace handling
      starters.ts          Starter notebooks (Getting started, Sketchbook, …)
      appearance.ts        Palette + font tokens
      cell-references.ts   @name reference resolver
      source.ts            Source-import helpers
      io.ts                Project import/export wire format
    error-component.tsx    Root error boundary (mounted via src/router.tsx)
scripts/
  build-artifacts.mjs      Rebuilds public/folio-runtime/ (kernel + per-library bundles)
public/
  folio-runtime/           Built bundles (regenerated on dev/build)
  favicon.svg
```

## 3. Runtime model

### 3.1 Cell evaluation

A cell runs inside a sandboxed iframe (`src/lib/notebook/sandbox-kernel.ts`). The iframe loads `kernel-frame.ts` (built by `scripts/build-artifacts.mjs` → `kernel-<hash>.js`) which sets up a per-notebook JS scope and exposes the cell helpers.

Top-level declarations declared by `const` / `let` / `var` / `function` are harvested into a shared scope (`__folioScope__`) so subsequent cells see them. Block-scoped declarations (`{ const x = … }`) are intentionally not harvested — this matches notebook expectations and avoids surprising leakage.

The cell's `source` is parsed by `@babel/parser`. Reserved names (`__folioScope__`, `__folioLibraries`, `__folioHost__`, etc.) cannot be redeclared.

### 3.2 Output

A run produces a `CellOutput`:

```ts
type CellOutput = {
  logs: LogLine[];      // captured console.* output
  displays: Display[];  // rendered beneath the cell
};

type LogLine = { level: "log" | "info" | "warn" | "error"; text: string };

type Display =
  | { kind: "text"; text: string }
  | { kind: "html"; html: string }      // sanitized via DOMPurify
  | { kind: "image"; src: string; alt?: string }
  | { kind: "table"; columns: string[]; rows: string[][] }
  | { kind: "json"; json: string }
  | { kind: "error"; message: string; stack?: string };
```

`inspect(value)` returns a `Display`:

- `string` / `number` / `bigint` / `boolean` / `null` / `undefined` / `symbol` → text
- `function` → `[Function name]`
- `HtmlValue` (from `html` tagged template) → html
- `MdValue` (from `md` tagged template) → html (rendered through `marked`)
- `TableValue` (from `table(...)`) → table
- `HTMLCanvasElement` → image (toDataURL)
- `HTMLImageElement` → image
- `HTMLElement` → html (outerHTML)
- `Error` → error
- `Date` → text (ISO)
- Array of plain records → table
- Otherwise → json

### 3.3 Cell helpers

Cells can call:

| Helper     | Purpose                                                   |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `chart(data, options?)` | Declarative chart (recharts-based).            |
| `sketch(w, h, fn)`      | `<canvas>` 2D drawing; `fn(ctx)` paints.        |
| `html\`…\`` (tagged template) | Raw HTML; sanitized through DOMPurify.    |
| `md\`…\`` (tagged template)   | Markdown; rendered through `marked`.         |
| `table(data)`            | Tabular data; rendered as a grid.             |

These are exposed via `globalThis.__folioLibraries` populated by the per-group IIFE bundles in `public/folio-runtime/` (`core`, `icons`, `three`, `fiber`, `charts`, `data`, `math`, `text`). The kernel loads these on boot.

### 3.4 Bundled libraries (catalog)

| Module                        | Group   | What it does                            |
| ----------------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `react`, `react-dom`, `react/jsx-runtime`, `react/jsx-dev-runtime` | core | Components, hooks, JSX runtimes |
| `lucide-react`                | icons   | Interface icons                         |
| `three`, `three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js`, `three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js` | three | Three.js |
| `@react-three/fiber`, `@react-three/drei` | fiber | Declarative Three.js with React         |
| `recharts`                    | charts  | Responsive React charts                 |
| `d3`, `lodash-es`, `date-fns`, `papaparse`, `zod` | data | Visualization, parsing, validation |
| `mathjs`                      | math    | Expressions and arithmetic              |
| `marked`, `katex`             | text    | Markdown rendering, math typesetting    |

To add a new library, append to `src/lib/artifacts/catalog.json` with one of the existing groups and run `npm run artifacts:build`.

## 4. Persistence model

`useFolioStore` (Zustand + `persist` middleware) writes:

- `nodes` and `edges` (the canvas) — debounced by `delay` with a `maxDelay` cap so continuous typing still flushes.
- appearance (palette + font + custom tokens) — kept separately so users can change look without affecting notebook content.
- workspace index — multiple canvases can coexist under namespaced keys.

The persistence driver (`src/lib/notebook/persistence.ts`) prefers IndexedDB when available and falls back to `localStorage`. A small migration table is used to coordinate multi-tab edits: the writer reads the latest stored version, writes the new state with `version+1`, and a losing tab sees a conflict and reloads.

## 5. Source import (compiler)

`src/lib/artifacts/compiler.ts` walks the static graph from a chosen entry file:

- Supports `.js`, `.jsx`, `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.mjs`, `.cjs`.
- Traces literal `import` and `export from` paths and literal `require('...')` calls.
- Reports missing files, unsupported packages, dynamic imports, and non-literal `require` calls.
- Uses esbuild for bundling (server-side, on demand).
- The result is a single bundle script that the existing sandbox iframe can run.

`scripts/build-artifacts.mjs` produces the runtime libraries (`core`, `icons`, `three`, `fiber`, `charts`, `data`, `math`, `text`) as hashed IIFE bundles under `public/folio-runtime/`, plus a `manifest.json` listing filenames + versions. `predev`/`prebuild` run it automatically.

## 6. Project export

`src/lib/artifacts/project-export.ts` produces a downloadable ZIP:

- The original source files (preserved for tests).
- A generated React entrypoint + Vite config + `package.json` (pinned from the installed preview libs).
- `codefolio.build.json` with the chosen module graph.
- A build smoke test.

Reproducibility rule: the same source and library versions produce the same archive bytes. Extracted projects run with `npm install`, `npm run dev` (port 5174), `npm run build`, `npm run preview` (port 5175). The in-app preview can run literal CommonJS `require`, but exports report such files as build errors because Vite would not reproduce them reliably. Server routes are not synthesized.

## 7. AI assistance (optional)

The project-assistant path uses `libfx/node` on the server. Configure one of:

- `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` for AI Gateway.
- `FX_GATEWAY_CHAT_URL`, `FX_LOCAL_API_KEY`, optionally `FX_LOCAL_MODEL` for a local fx Gateway-compatible chat endpoint.

The agent has no tools; source and error text are bounded; requests time out after 30 seconds. When deterministic compilation fails, the handler asks for one replacement file, compiles again, and presents it for review before applying — proposals only, never automatic changes.

## 8. Conventions

- Strict TypeScript. `tsc --noEmit` must pass.
- Tailwind v4, entry `src/styles.css` (`@import "tailwindcss";`).
- Zustand for cross-cutting notebook state.
- React Query / Router client APIs are imported per feature.
- Runtime helpers that a cell can call live in `src/lib/notebook/inspect.ts`; new helpers get a test next door.
- No server-only code in client bundles (`src/router.tsx` and route loaders are fine for server logic; pure browser code stays in components).
- Don't commit `node_modules/`, `dist/`, or anything under `public/folio-runtime/`.
- The kernel is single-threaded JS in a sandbox frame — don't bring in another state library or a build step on its runtime path.

## 9. Adding things

### Adding a runtime helper

1. Implement in `src/lib/notebook/inspect.ts` (typed + documented).
2. Add a focused test in `src/lib/notebook/*.test.ts`.
3. If the helper needs a third-party lib, add an entry to `src/lib/artifacts/catalog.json` and rebuild via `npm run artifacts:build`.

### Adding a cell kind

1. New renderer in `src/components/notebook/<kind>-cell.tsx`.
2. Add the kind to `Cell` (`src/lib/notebook/types.ts`) and the store's persist/load paths.
3. Cover render + persistence in `src/lib/notebook/store.test.ts`.

## 10. Scripts

| Script              | What it does                                        |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run dev`       | Vite dev server on port 5173                        |
| `npm run build`     | Production build to `dist/`                         |
| `npm run build:dev` | Development-mode build                              |
| `npm run preview`   | Serve the built output                              |
| `npm run typecheck` | `tsc --noEmit`                                      |
| `npm test`          | `node --import tsx --test src/lib/{notebook,artifacts}/*.test.ts` |
| `npm run lint`      | ESLint                                              |
| `npm run format`    | Prettier                                            |
| `npm run artifacts:build` | Re-bundle the notebook kernel + library bundles  |

`predev` and `prebuild` automatically run `artifacts:build`.
